originality.rationale: The count and twenty-orbit refinement over all fields are not stated in inspected closest primary papers. An–Bai (2007) already gives full characteristic-zero operator normal forms for this very three-dimensional algebra: the new claim expressly excludes originality of that classification and compares its logical coverage. Jian (2013) gives only general projection construction; full M2 and weight-zero results involve other ambient algebras/identities. Remaining risk of derivation from preexisting normal forms is explicit.
residual_risks: An–Bai 2007 operator normal forms might be specialized to recover some or all 20 orbit types, though its paper does not enumerate them or provide finite-field formulas.
Li–Liu full-M2 classification might indirectly imply triangular results if extension and stabilizer correspondences are added, which were not established.
No independently certified complete global historical search.
